## Core Offerings
1. ASME B16.48 positive isolation paddle blinds and spacer rings (SA-516 Gr. 70, SA-36, 304L, 316L, 6061-T6 aluminum) with EN 10204 3.1 MTRs
2. CNC plasma plate cutting and practical industrial welding
3. Structural steel fabrication and custom sheet metal
4. Agricultural and ranch equipment: pens, gates, fence components
5. Public-sector infrastructure steel: fire rings, handrails, park metalwork
6. Secure specialty builds: custom bunkers, tornado shelters, large built-in safes
7. O&G turnaround support parts and assemblies

## Logistics Model
- Local / regional: Texas Gulf Coast hot-shot and site delivery (Bay City, Matagorda County, Brazoria County, Freeport, Lake Jackson, Angleton, Pearland, Houston corridor)
- Nationwide: UPS Ground parcel for boxed blinds/parts; LTL pallet freight; dedicated flatbed for heavy equipment — all 50 US states
